review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the code accompanying a Lean metaprogramming video series.
The 18 current-primary files define/check tactics, custom sorry handling, definitional equality, elaboration/intro/negation/rewrite examples, state and Lean-search/LeanAide interactions.
Fiddle/example naming is intrinsic to this educational metaprogramming source and does not establish a content-lossless duplicate or runner layer.
summary: Retain MetaExamples in full as a compact corpus of Lean metaprogramming examples and tactic/elaboration demonstrations.
